features.t: Container Apps Environments (create, list, get, delete)
x: The environment's own virtual network, static IP and default domain are generated; there is no real network fabric behind them.

features.t: Dapr components, certificates and workload profiles
x: Dapr components are stored and returned to the azure-mgmt-appcontainers SDK / az CLI exactly as configured; there is no running Dapr sidecar to actually invoke state/pub-sub/binding calls through them. Certificates and workload profile counts are likewise stored, not provisioned against real compute capacity.

Logs (POST managedEnvironments/{env}/logs) aggregates the real console logs of every app container in the environment with a substring filter -- not a Log Analytics/KQL pipeline; Diagnose runs the per-app detectors. Offline appliance with the Docker compute backend (Pro/Max): real. Nano / no Docker: the operation answers 409 RuntimeUnavailable (no container runtime in a browser tab).

features.t: Container Apps (create, list, get, delete, start/stop)
x: Replica execution is simulated bookkeeping (minReplicas when active, 0 when stopped/inactive) unless the offline appliance's Docker runtime hook is attached, in which case the active revision's image really runs as a container.

features.t: Revisions and replicas (list, activate, deactivate, restart)
x: A changed container template creates a real new revision with its own name/FQDN; health state and running state are reported, not probed from a live process (unless the offline Docker runtime hook is attached).
FQDNs are generated and traffic weights are validated to sum to 100 and stored for real; there is no real reverse proxy routing HTTP traffic by weight between revisions.

minReplicas/maxReplicas really bound the replica count Vyomi reports and (with the Docker runtime hook) runs; custom scale rules (HTTP concurrency, CPU, custom) are stored and returned but never evaluated — Vyomi does not scale a revision in response to real load.
Secret values never leave a GET/List (matching real ARM); listSecrets reveals them for real, and a container's env var secretRef is validated against the app's own secret set.

The platform-enabled flag and unauthenticated-request action are stored and returned to az containerapp auth show/update for real; there is no running ingress to actually redirect a request to a login page, and identity provider configuration (Entra ID, Google, Facebook, GitHub, Apple, X, OpenID Connect) is not modelled.

listCustomHostNameAnalysis is a real call that returns the CNAME record Vyomi expects; Vyomi does not persist a bound custom domain or managed certificate against the app (there is no hostNameBindings-style sub-resource for Container Apps, unlike App Service).
Enabling a system-assigned identity mints a stable principalId/tenantId that can be the subject of a role assignment on Access control (IAM); user-assigned identities are not modelled.

features.t: Networking, Dapr configuration, Service Connector, Console, Continuous deployment
x: Environment custom VNet integration is real configuration: the infrastructure subnet must exist and be at least a /23 (/27 with workload profiles), cannot be shared between environments, internal mode and zoneRedundant require a subnet, platformReservedCidr must not overlap the vnet, and the VNet configuration is immutable after create. Packets are not routed through the subnet, so the environment's ingress works identically with and without it. App-level Dapr sidecar enablement, Service Connector linkage, an in-browser exec console and a CI/CD source-to-image pipeline are still not modelled.

Log stream (GET/POST containerApps/{app}/logstream) returns the app container's real stdout/stderr (docker logs) and Console (POST .../exec) runs commands in it (docker exec); metrics come from docker stats (GET .../vyomiMetrics). Offline appliance with the Docker compute backend (Pro/Max): real. Nano / no Docker: the operation answers 409 RuntimeUnavailable (no container runtime in a browser tab). Log lines are a snapshot tail, not a websocket stream.

Events lists the app's system events (container started/stopped/restarted, console commands); Diagnose and solve problems runs detectors over the REAL container state and recent log errors; revision Restart really restarts the container. Offline appliance with the Docker compute backend (Pro/Max): real. Nano / no Docker: the operation answers 409 RuntimeUnavailable (no container runtime in a browser tab).

features.t: Container Apps Jobs (create, delete, run, stop, secrets, execution history)
x: An execution's status is reported Succeeded immediately (no real workload runs the job's container); Manual/Schedule trigger configuration is validated and stored for real, including the cron expression.

features.t: Diagnose and solve problems, Identity, Log stream
x: Job executions run as REAL one-shot containers (docker run): the exit code decides Succeeded/Failed and the container output is the execution's log (GET jobs/{job}/executions/{e}/logs); Diagnose and Events reflect those runs; the job resource stores a system/user-assigned identity over ARM (the console Identity blade for jobs is not built). Offline appliance with the Docker compute backend (Pro/Max): real. Nano / no Docker: the operation answers 409 RuntimeUnavailable (no container runtime in a browser tab). Without a runtime an execution is only recorded (no log).

features.t: Access control (IAM): role assignments and built-in role definitions over ARM
x: Role assignments and role definitions are real ARM resources (Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments, roleDefinitions). The Role assignments list is ENFORCED scoped to this resource (plus its subscription/resource-group ancestors, matching real Azure's inherited-access view) instead of the whole subscription — the same engine the App Service/Cosmos DB/VM blades use; Roles stays subscription-wide, which matches real Azure.
